annotations.title: The desk lab board — paper strategy arms

description: Every live strategy arm in Rokha's desk lab: id, strategy id, status (queued · trial · graduated · probation · tossed), the submitter's hypothesis, its Signet paper ledger, its rig, its graded record and when it was graded. A strategy's spec (its thresholds) is never shown. include_signals adds each arm's latest planned buys/sells — live for its owner and buyers, otherwise only entries older than the embargo, with the unlock door. Market data, not advice. Public, no auth.

include_signals.description: Add each arm's latest signals (max 10 per arm).
